representation_assumptions: The three carboxyl groups use the neutral COOH form depicted in the source drawing; their physiological protonation states are unresolved.
The source labels the terminal substituent N3. The SMILES uses the conventional resonance form C-N=N+=N-; this is a representation choice, not a distinct regioisomer claim.

Map IDs 1-83 provide stable identifiers for this graph. Only the roof-tail carbons C21-C23 inherit explicit numbering from the source figure; the remaining IDs are graph identifiers, not authoritative PDB atom names.
The source 2D drawing does not assign atom stereocentres; no atom stereochemistry is added.
limitations: This is an isolated roof macrocycle propyl-azide graph, not the complete NNC2215 insulin conjugate.
The graph has not been mapped one-to-one to either public NNC2215 PDB model.
Simulation-pH protonation, partial charges, force-field parameters, and target-MD readiness remain unresolved.
